To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Legionella colonization was detected in the water system of all three hospitals, and the Legionella isolate from the patient matched the isolate from one of the hospitals.
Legionella pneumophilaserogroup 3 was isolated from the water system of the first hospital and that the patient isolate matched this isolate by molecular typing.
Legionella pneumophia was detected in the water supply of three hospitals and that the patient isolate matched one of the environmental isolates by molecular subtyping.

the investigation of the Legionella outbreak in Taiwan.
the development of a novel, simple and rapid detection technique for the detection and identification of L. pneumophila.
